name: messenger-catchup
description: Dev tooling for the Messenger Catch-up skill (tests only; the skill itself ships via make-zip.sh)

scripts.setup: playwright install chromium && npm run hooks && npm run setup:py
scripts.fmt: prettier --write 'assets/*.html' 'assets/*.js' 'tests/*.js' 'tests/mock/*.html' && .venv/bin/ruff format scripts tests tools && npm run sync
scripts.test: npm run fmt:check && npm run test:py && npm run test:sim && npm run test:page
